name: Halifax County, NC
findings: Halifax County has 127 nonprofit organizations. 48 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 39 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Halifax County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
